title: LLM fundamentals and inference
summary: Explain token generation and model limits well enough to debug applications without treating the model as an oracle.
focus: Tokens, attention and next-token prediction; Decoding, inference cost and uncertainty

title: Model APIs, structured output and streaming
summary: Create a typed provider boundary that handles partial responses and failure honestly.
focus: Typed requests and validated results; Streaming is an event protocol

title: Tool calling and dispatch from primitives
summary: Build a controlled bridge from model proposals to deterministic application operations.
focus: Schemas are contracts, tool calls are proposals; Dispatch, permissions and execution budgets

title: Agent execution loops and context management
summary: Implement the loop yourself and make each transition inspectable.
focus: The agent is a state machine; Context is a budgeted working set

title: MCP architecture and versioned interoperability
summary: Learn the actual protocol boundary and integrate tools without confusing MCP with model tool calling.
focus: Hosts, clients, servers and protocol revisions; Transport, tool discovery and authentication

title: Durable state and recoverable orchestration
summary: Make runs resumable without duplicating external actions.
focus: Event history, checkpoints and replay; Workflows before open-ended autonomy

title: Retrieval and grounded answers
summary: Build a measurable search pipeline before adding agentic retrieval complexity.
focus: Indexing, chunking and retrieval evaluation; Hybrid search, reranking and grounded generation

title: Memory and context lifecycle
summary: Separate searchable memory from raw artifacts and enforce retention and provenance.
focus: History, working memory and long-term records; Artifacts, hydration and consistency

title: Evaluation and regression engineering
summary: Measure task success and failure modes with repeatable datasets rather than impressive demos.
focus: Datasets, scorers and experimental discipline; Stochasticity, replay and adversarial regression

title: Permissions, prompt injection and sandboxing
summary: Enforce authority in code and contain untrusted tool inputs and outputs.
focus: Prompt injection and the confused deputy; Sandbox boundaries and credential scope

title: Latency, observability and production reliability
summary: Operate agent runs as budgeted distributed workloads with partial failures.
focus: Tracing runs and controlling cost; Latency budgets, routing and graceful failure

title: Independent agent harness capstone
summary: Integrate primitives into a reliable Python harness and compare it with established implementations.
focus: Designing the harness boundaries; Release review and framework comparison

title: Multi-agent systems
summary: Evaluate whether decomposition improves a task enough to justify coordination overhead.

title: Advanced RAG and memory
summary: Explore retrieval planning, temporal memory and ablation-driven improvements.

title: Local models and inference systems
summary: Understand serving, quantization and hardware tradeoffs without assuming local means free.

title: Multimodal agents
summary: Add images and other artifacts while preserving ordering, provenance and bounded hydration.

title: Agent security and isolation engineering
summary: Test containment against concrete generated-code and tool abuse scenarios.

title: Model engineering and adaptation
summary: Learn when fine-tuning is justified and how to evaluate it against prompting and retrieval.
focus: Training objectives, LoRA and data quality

title: Evaluation infrastructure
summary: Build scalable, reviewable evaluation operations and protect benchmark integrity.
focus: Evaluation as a production data pipeline
